name: Timeline
rows: Date
Event
Significance
Attacker accesses and downloads encrypted export file containing 550 distinct consumers; decryption key also obtained
Notification event occurs; no reliable evidence negating unauthorized acquisition
Non-involved employee Alex confirms the above facts
DISCOVERY DATE under §314.4(j)(2) — event known to employee other than person committing breach; 30-day clock starts
Management reads incident report
Internal escalation; no legal significance for discovery date (already triggered 03-03)
External counsel/investigators engaged; baseline date for this memo
Investigation underway; remediation in progress; FTC notice deadline approaching
Police verbally request no public disclosure; no written determination, no specified duration, no order preventing FTC report
§314.4(j)(1)(vi) requires WRITTEN determination for delay; oral request has NO legal effect on FTC notification deadline; may be noted in notice but does not defer filing
FTC NOTIFICATION DEADLINE (30 calendar days from 2025-03-03)
Must submit electronically by this date; 'as soon as possible' obligation also applies — do not wait until deadline
2025-04-02 + 30 days (if LE writes)
Initial LE delay period (up to 30 days from FTC filing date) — only if written determination obtained
Does NOT delay FTC filing; only delays public disclosure by FTC
2025-04-02 + 90 days (if LE extends in writing)
Extended LE delay (additional 60 days) — only if LE seeks extension in writing
Further public disclosure delay; FTC already notified
